dogecoin.text:
Meme coins mooning while your portfolio's in the gutter?  
Little Pepe's building a blockchain empire,  
and Dogecoin's still Elon's lapdog.  
AI coins flexing, but half these tokens are just hype.  
Pick your poison, degen - it's a wild ride. 🦍

Catslap slappin' Dogecoin's face off!  
Solana's memecoins runnin' wild, Ethereum's chokin' on fees.  
Trump coins? Fartcoin's got more gas.  
AI tokens flexin', but Pepe's still king.  
Get in or get rekt, crypto's no place for soft hands.
